original: Heavy closed helmet with a dark visor. Holds large calibres and shrapnel. Mounts for night vision and a flashlight.
english: Heavy closed helmet with a dark visor. Holds large calibres and shrapnel. Mounts for night vision and a flashlight.
russian: Тяжёлый закрытый шлем с тёмным забралом. Держит крупный калибр и осколки. Крепления для прибора ночного видения и фонаря.

original: Sealed face mask of the exoskeleton. Keeps out gas and infection.
english: Sealed face mask of the exoskeleton. Keeps out gas and infection.
russian: Герметичная маска экзоскелета. Не пропускает газ и заразу.

original: Class 6 armour plates on the exoskeleton frame, with many pouches. Holster and grenade loops.
english: Class 6 armour plates on the exoskeleton frame, with many pouches. Holster and grenade loops.
russian: Бронеплиты 6 класса на каркасе экзоскелета и много подсумков. Есть кобура и петли для гранат.

original: Worn on the belt. The drive takes up to 120 kg of load off the wearer and carries a lot of gear.
english: Worn on the belt. The drive takes up to 120 kg of load off the wearer and carries a lot of gear.
russian: Носится на поясе. Привод снимает с бойца до 120 кг груза, в отсеки помещается много снаряжения.

original: Jacket with the upper exoskeleton frame. Takes up to 30 kg off the shoulders, lots of pockets.
english: Jacket with the upper exoskeleton frame. Takes up to 30 kg off the shoulders, lots of pockets.
russian: Куртка с верхним каркасом экзоскелета. Снимает с плеч до 30 кг груза, много карманов.

original: Trousers with the leg frame of the exoskeleton. Take up to 30 kg off the legs, lots of pockets.
english: Trousers with the leg frame of the exoskeleton. Take up to 30 kg off the legs, lots of pockets.
russian: Штаны с ножным каркасом экзоскелета. Снимают с ног до 30 кг груза, много карманов.

original: Armoured gloves of the exoskeleton. Protect hands from blows and chemicals.
english: Armoured gloves of the exoskeleton. Protect hands from blows and chemicals.
russian: Бронированные перчатки экзоскелета. Защищают руки от ударов и химии.

original: Heavy exoskeleton boots with an armoured toe and a knife sheath.
english: Heavy exoskeleton boots with an armoured toe and a knife sheath.
russian: Тяжёлые ботинки экзоскелета с бронированным носком и ножнами.
